entities.summary: Wilhelm or William Hillebrand was a German physician. He practiced medicine in several countries, including the Hawaiian Islands for over 20 years. In 1850, Hillebrand lived at what is now Foster Botanical Garden in Honolulu and gained acknowledgement as a botanist.
